message: Mike:  I enjoyed reading this thoughtful post.  I predict that like most of us who have had a chance to work closely with Afghans you will be charmed by your counterparts and will be heartsick at the thought that the progressive, Westward-leaning Afghanistan they represent is in such jeopardy. I can't wait to see how your perceptions of these matters will have been sharpened by your experience when you return next summer.  Stay safe, and enjoy to the maximum extent possible.  -Pete
